name: Phantom MK1
summary: A camera-first industrial and defence humanoid from Foundation Robotics Labs, built around proprietary back-drivable cycloidal actuators (up to ~160 Nm) and a hybrid classical-plus-LLM control stack. Foundation reached first shipment about 13 months after founding; in early 2026 two units were sent to Ukraine for frontline testing.
notable: Concept to first shipment in ~13 months
Reported first deployment of a humanoid to an active combat zone (2026)

sources.title: Foundation Emerges With 'Phantom' Humanoid — Humanoids Daily
